findings.ref: DoD-4, spec demo «Логи и аудит», MCC-08, AC-M3-08
findings.problem: logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(message)s") is what makes the INFO JSON audit lines reach stdout in the real process. Its 6 mutants (level=None, no level, format=None, no format, XX%(message)sXX, %(MESSAGE)S) survive and are listed as equivalent with the reason 'checked in docker logs by docker_smoke.sh / critic'. False: docker_smoke greps only startup_refused (ERROR level). Critic built level=None into the image: docker_smoke OK, live container wrote 0 log lines for 30 tool calls (15 audit lines per run normally). A non-equivalent survivor in a mutated module passes the CI gate via the list (DoD-4). The basicConfig line itself dates from cycle 1; listing it as equivalent is new in this cycle.
findings.required_improvement: Add an automated real-process check that a JSON audit line (keys tool, outcome) is written to stdout: e.g. in docker_smoke.sh make one tools/call (a refused one is enough) and grep docker logs, or a subprocess test of python -m demo_connector. Then drop x_main__mutmut_1..6 from mutmut-equivalent.txt or relabel them 'killed by <check>' with a true reason.

findings.problem: The test-controls server (:8090 on 127.0.0.1) is never started by any test; port 8091 / default 8000, XX127.0.0.1XX, Server(None), test_app(None) survive. Test profile only, absent from the production image, so no production exposure.
findings.required_improvement: Factor the uvicorn.Config list into a function and assert [(host, port)] for test and production settings in-process; keep only asyncio.run listed.

findings.problem: The empty-board-set shortcut returns before _offset(): reader with {board_ids: [], cursor: 'garbage'} -> success, with board_ids [a-public] -> invalid_input (reproduced on the live image). The 7-line empty-result literal duplicates what the general path builds from no notes.
findings.required_improvement: Validate the cursor first and skip only the backend call: notes, method, timed_out = ([], None, False) if not boards else await self.backend.search(...); remove the literal (-7 lines).

findings.problem: except Exception keeps no diagnostic: the audit line has only outcome internal_error, no exception type or traceback anywhere; with a real backend a bug cannot be told from an outage.
findings.required_improvement: Add "error": type(exc).__name__ to the audit entry (class name, no provider text).

required_improvements: DoD-4 / audit log: an automated check that the real process writes a JSON audit line to stdout (docker_smoke.sh tools/call + grep of docker logs, or a subprocess test), and mutmut-equivalent.txt without the 6 basicConfig mutants listed as equivalent (removed, or relabelled with the check that kills them). With this alone, and no new problems, the score is >= 9; findings 2-4 go to the backlog if not done.
